config.SlimeHutch_Background.name: Background
config.section.Background.name: Background
config.section.Background.description: This affects the look of the interior. Your choice will also affect the lighting.
config.SlimeHutch_Left_Floor.name: Left floor type
config.SlimeHutch_Left_Floor.description: Changes the floor on the left side.
config.section.Inside_flooring.name: Inside Flooring
config.section.Inside_flooring.descripti: This only affects the flooring in front of the window or wall (the 'inside' part of the greenhouse).
config.SlimeHutch_Right_Floor.name: Right floor type
config.SlimeHutch_Right_Floor.descriptio: Changes the floor on the right side.
config.SlimeHutch_Middle_Floor.name: Middle floor type
config.SlimeHutch_Middle_Floor.descripti: Changes the strip of floor in the middle.
config.InsideGrass.name: Inside grass floor season
config.InsideGrass.description: If grass is chosen for any inside floor type, this changes the seasonal look of the grass.  Choosing 'Match' will make it match the actual game season.
config.SlimeHutch_Clip.name: Clipping (overlapping)
config.SlimeHutch_Clip.description: Whether to allow clipping (overlapping) over the walls (when fruit trees are growing alongside them, for example). Only applies to left and right walls, not the back.
config.section.SlimeHutch_Clip.name: Clipping
config.section.SlimeHutch_Clip.descripti: This affects whether overlapping is allowed along the sides.
config.SlimeHutch_Left_Layout.name: Left layout type
config.SlimeHutch_Left_Layout.descriptio: What type of layout do you want on the left side of the Slime Hutch?
config.section.Layout.name: Crop or Tree Layout
config.section.Layout.description: If you want to raise crops or fruit trees, choose the layout here. Each side can have a different layout.
config.SlimeHutch_Right_Layout.name: Right layout type
config.SlimeHutch_Right_Layout.descripti: What type of layout do you want on the right side of the Slime Hutch?
config.SlimeHutch_Left_Crop_Size.name: Size of left crop beds
config.SlimeHutch_Left_Crop_Size.descrip: Optimizes the left side crop bed for 3x3, 5x5, or 7x7 squares. This setting only matters if you chose Crops for the Left Layout type, otherwise it will do nothing.
config.section.Crop_layout.name: Crop bed size (Crops only)
config.section.Crop_layout.description: Optimizes the crop fields for different sprinkler types. 'Divided' versions put wood between the squares. Each side can have a different layout.
config.SlimeHutch_Right_Crop_Size.name: Size of right crop beds
config.SlimeHutch_Right_Crop_Size.descri: Optimizes the right side crop bed for 3x3, 5x5, or 7x7 squares. This setting only matters if you chose Crops for the Right Layout type, otherwise it will do nothing.
config.SlimeHutch_Left_FruitTrees.name: Fruit tree left side layout
config.SlimeHutch_Left_FruitTrees.descri: Provides optional planting guides for fruit trees on the left side. This setting only matters if you chose Fruit Trees for the Left Layout type, otherwise it will do nothing.
config.section.Fruit_Tree_layout.name: Fruit Tree layout (Fruit Trees only)
config.section.Fruit_Tree_layout.descrip: Provides optional planting guides for fruit trees. Fruit trees can also be planted on any floor tile.
config.SlimeHutch_Right_FruitTrees.name: Fruit tree right side layout
config.SlimeHutch_Right_FruitTrees.descr: Provides optional planting guides for fruit trees on the right side. This setting only matters if you chose Fruit Trees for the Right Layout type, otherwise it will do nothing.
config.SlimeHutch_Left_TrellisCrops.name: Trellis Crop left side layout
config.SlimeHutch_Left_TrellisCrops.desc: Optimizes the left side crop beds for trellis crops. This setting only matters if you chose Trellis Crops for the Left Layout type, otherwise it will do nothing.
config.section.Trellis_Crops.name: Trellis Crop layout (Trellis Crops only)
config.section.Trellis_Crops.description: Optimizes the crop fields for trellis crops so that every crop is accessible. Each side can have a different layout.
config.SlimeHutch_Right_TrellisCrops.des: Optimizes the right side crop beds for trellis crops. This setting only matters if you chose Trellis Crops for the Right Layout type, otherwise it will do nothing.
config.WaterCropsStyle.name: Irrigated Crop Style
config.WaterCropsStyle.description: The color palette to use for the irrigated crop layout. This setting only matters if you chose Irrigated Crops for one of the Layout types, otherwise it will do nothing.
config.section.Water_Crops.name: Irrigated Crop Style (Water Crops only)
config.section.Water_Crops.description: Slightly changes the look of the pieces surrounding the water square. This setting only matters if you chose Irrigated Crops for one of the Layout types, otherwise it will do nothing.
config.SlimeHutch_Left_WaterSource.name: Water Source on the left side.
config.SlimeHutch_Left_WaterSource.descr: The design of the water source on the left side. Will NOT feed slimes!
config.section.Water_Source.name: Water Source (for watering cans only)
config.section.Water_Source.description: Adds a water source suitable for refilling your watering can. NOTE: This will not feed slimes!
config.SlimeHutch_Right_WaterSource.name: Water Source on the right side.
config.SlimeHutch_Right_WaterSource.desc: The design of the water source on the right side. Will NOT feed slimes!
config.Left_Slime_Water_Feeders.name: Left side slime water feeders
config.Left_Slime_Water_Feeders.descript: Adds water feeders for slimes on the left side. You will need at least one feeder if you wish to raise slimes.
config.Left_Slime_Water_Feeders.values.B: Both far left and middle feeders
config.section.SlimeRaising.name: Slime Raising
config.section.SlimeRaising.description: Adds water feeders for slime raising. You will need at least one feeder if you wish to raise slimes.
config.Right_Slime_Water_Feeders.name: Right side slime water feeders.
config.Right_Slime_Water_Feeders.descrip: Adds water feeders for slimes on the right side. You will need at least one feeder if you wish to raise slimes.
Both far right and middle feeders
config.Top_Slime_Water_Feeders.name: Top slime water feeders.
config.Top_Slime_Water_Feeders.descripti: Adds water feeders for slimes on the top of the greenhouse background (behind the glass).
config.section.Greenhouse_style.name: Greenhouse style
config.section.Greenhouse_style.descript: Changes the look of the greenhouse background. This setting only matters if Greenhouse is chosen for the Background, otherwise it will do nothing.
config.SlimeHutch_Outside_Floor.name: Outside floor type
config.SlimeHutch_Outside_Floor.descript: The outside floor type for the Greenhouse (behind the glass). This setting only matters if Greenhouse is chosen for the Background, otherwise it will do nothing.
config.OutsideGrass.name: Outside grass floor season
config.OutsideGrass.description: If light or dark grass is chosen for the outside floor type above, this changes the seasonal look of the grass.  Choosing 'Match' will make it match the actual game season. This setting only matters if Greenhouse is chosen for the Background, otherwise it will do nothing.
config.SlimeHutch_GreenhouseFrame.name: Greenhouse Frame Color
config.SlimeHutch_GreenhouseFrame.descri: The color of the glass frame of the Greenhouse. This only matters if you chose Greenhouse for Background, otherwise it will do nothing.
config.SlimeHutch_GreenhouseGlass.name: Greenhouse glass style
config.SlimeHutch_GreenhouseGlass.descri: Whether you want glossy or completely clear glass. This setting only matters if Greenhouse is chosen for the Background, otherwise it will do nothing.
config.SlimeHutch_GreenhouseLeaves.name: Greenhouse leaves season
config.SlimeHutch_GreenhouseLeaves.descr: Which season the leaves surrounding the top of the greenhouse should display. Choosing Match will make it match the actual game season. This only matters if you chose Greenhouse for Background, otherwise it will do nothing.
config.SlimeHutch_GreenhouseTree.name: Big tree
config.SlimeHutch_GreenhouseTree.descrip: Adds a large decorative tree behind the grass and changes the tree's season. Choosing Match will make it match the actual game season. This only matters if you chose Greenhouse for Background, otherwise it will do nothing.
